steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: H-how is this possible? How did we get beaten by two little girls?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: What did she say just now? "Chief"...?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: I get it now! She's from the higher-ups, those privileged *****! She's here to sabotage Rustfire's mission! She's not worthy of being a Sinner! We are the true Sinners!!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Come! Finish her off and then get more people from the Drifter Camp! We have more than enough people!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Is it the Drifter Camp? Is Chief in the Drifter Camp?
Nightmare roars and clears a path. Hecate jumps onto its claws and starts heading towards the Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you screaming about? I'm still around. Where do you scumbags think you're going?
Hella leans against her water pipe, struggling to stand up.
The burden of the shackles proved to be too great. Coupled with attacks from so many "Sinners," she ended up getting injured.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: For **** sake, Hecate, you're way too fast, I can't catch up... Wait up... These wounds are just scratches, they'll heal soon enough...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: **** it hurts so much... Why must these stupid shackles mess up at a time like this... Idiot... Look at what that fool's doing without you around...
The roaring hoodlums run up from behind towards Hecate's direction.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But... it can't be helped. You're ${PlayerName}, after all... If you're gone for good, Hecate will get locked up in that lab again.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If you can't stop yourself, I wish you all the best, Hecate... Go bring ${PlayerName} back...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't worry about those hoodlums behind you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I... won't let them get in your way!
